name: bar-layout-drift-and-push-geometry
title: [bar-layout] 重构几何合同以支持section整体漂移、显式左右端坐标与稳定推挤动画
description: Refactor the bar layout geometry contract so sections and widgets expose explicit left/right edges, alignment semantics, drift ranges, and push offsets. The new model must support whole-section drift and separate local slot layout from section-level push displacement.
creator: opencode-agent
notes: Opened after repeated push/displacement regressions while integrating bar-expanded window hint width ownership. The current left/center/right result-oriented geometry is not expressive enough for whole-section drift or stable push semantics.
